# Soaring Symbols Website

The shared agent instructions for this repository live in `AGENTS.md` at the repository root. Read and follow them for every task; this file only adds what is specific to Copilot.

## Copilot specifics

- `.github/instructions/nuxt-ui.instructions.md` applies to `.vue` and `.ts` files and points to the UI rules in `AGENTS.md`, including lining up text with `cap-center`.
